fields.name: interactiveMapUrl
fields.label: Interactive Map Url
fields.description: Embed link (e.g. a Google My Maps plot map) — opens from the "Interactive map" button in the listing hero.

fields.name: view360Url
fields.label: Street View embed URL
fields.description: Embed link (e.g. a Google Street View panorama, from Share > Embed a map) — opens from the "Street View" button in the listing hero. Leave blank to use the Coordinates.

fields.name: brochureUrl
fields.label: Brochure URL
fields.description: PDF URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Url
fields.description: YouTube/Vimeo link — or upload a video file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: badges
fields.label: Badges
fields.description: Marketing trust badges, e.g. "Easy Payment Plan"

fields.name: facilities
fields.label: Facilities
fields.description: General parcel characteristics, e.g. "Wide Road", "Corner Plot"

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: The developer's own one- or two-sentence description of this amenity, as published. Blank = the standard line is shown.

fields.name: key_other
fields.label: Category (Other)
fields.description: Custom value, used when Category above doesn't have the right option.

fields.name: field_other
fields.label: Feature (Other)
fields.description: Custom value, used when Feature above doesn't have the right option.

fields.name: value_other
fields.label: Value (Other)
fields.description: Custom value, used when Value above doesn't have the right option.

fields.name: ownershipServices
fields.label: Ownership & Services
fields.description: Shown in the "Ownership & Services" box on the listing. Only what the developer publishes.

fields.name: key_other
fields.label: Group (Other)
fields.description: Custom value, used when Group above doesn't have the right option.

fields.name: field_other
fields.label: Item (Other)
fields.description: Custom value, used when Item above doesn't have the right option.

fields.name: plotCount
fields.label: Total Plots (count only)
fields.description: Use this when the developer publishes only a total plot count, not individual plot numbers/sizes/prices (e.g. "Only 12 exclusive plots") — populating the Plots array below would mean inventing per-plot data that was never published. Falls back to the Plots array's own length when both are set.

fields.name: plots
fields.label: Plots
fields.description: Individual plots/lots within this land development — omit for a single unsubdivided parcel.

fields.name: priceLkr
fields.label: Price Lkr
fields.description: Leave blank when the developer does not publish a price for this plot.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status
fields.description: Leave blank when the developer does not say. Never guess.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: lat
fields.label: Lat
fields.description: Optional. Latitude — puts the place on the project/land map.

fields.name: lng
fields.label: Lng
fields.description: Optional. Longitude — puts the place on the project/land map.

fields.name: streetViewAvailable
fields.label: Street View Available
fields.description: Google Street View has no coverage on most roads in Sri Lanka — when there is none at these exact coordinates, the embed silently falls back to a zoomed-out world map instead of hiding itself. There is no live API check wired up (would need a Google Maps API key with billing enabled, which was declined), so this is set manually: uncheck it once you've confirmed (by opening the Street View tab on the live listing) that it just shows the world map, and the tab will stop showing for this listing. Leave checked (the default) for coordinates not yet checked, or already confirmed to have real coverage. Re-check any time the coordinates above change.

fields.name: address
fields.label: Address
fields.description: The listing's own sales-office address, if it has one.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Working hours
fields.description: e.g. 9am-5pm

fields.name: referenceLinks
fields.label: Links the owner shared
fields.description: Internal only. Where this listing's information came from: developer site, brochure PDF, video, map pin, third-party page.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: What it is, e.g. "Brochure PDF", "Developer site", "Google Maps pin".

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.description: Optional: date shared, what to check there.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Search engine & sharing
fields.description: What Google and social apps show for this page. Everything is optional — blank fields fall back to the page name and text.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: SEO title
fields.description: The blue headline in Google. Aim for about 60 characters or fewer. Blank = the page name.

fields.name: seoDescription
fields.label: SEO description
fields.description: The grey text under it. Aim for 120–160 characters.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Share image
fields.description: Picture shown when the page is shared. Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: canonicalUrl
fields.label: Canonical URL
fields.description: Only if this page should count as a copy of another address. Usually leave blank.

fields.name: noIndex
fields.label: Hide this page from search engines
